bridge_convention.provenance: the-tango tango.matchup.woba_delta_to_wpa/2 (DEC-2 Option A reuse); linear in pLI, critical constant pinned at pLI = li_critical_reference = 3.0. Sanity: 0.022 wOBA at li=3.0 -> 0.0121 WPA magnitude, inside the PRD's stated -0.010..-0.014 band.

delta_tango_woba.source: the-tango tango.params.DELTA_TANGO_WOBA: The Tango Cold-Bench Penalty, canonical figure from Tango et al., The Book (PRD 3.4).

high_li_threshold.source: the-tango tango.params.HIGH_LI_THRESHOLD: pLI above which pitches accrue the phi stress multiplier (PRD 3.2).

li_critical_reference.source: the-tango tango.matchup.LI_CRITICAL_REFERENCE (=3.0): leverage at which WOBA_TO_WPA_CRITICAL is expressed.

phi_high_li.source: the-tango tango.params.PHI_HIGH_LI: extra stress weight on pitches thrown at pLI > 1.5 (PRD 3.2).

runs_per_win.source: the-tango tango.params.RUNS_PER_WIN: runs per marginal win; converts run-scale costs to WPA.

woba_scale.source: the-tango tango.params.WOBA_SCALE: standard wOBA->runs scale (FanGraphs convention, ~1.15-1.30 by season).

woba_to_wpa_critical.source: the-tango tango.params.WOBA_TO_WPA_CRITICAL: converts a wOBA delta to a WPA delta in critical leverage; calibrated so that 0.022 wOBA maps into the PRD's stated -0.010..-0.014 WPA band. Scales with pLI. Uncalibrated.
